classes.definition: The exact unqualified class of sensing devices. This class definition excludes additional pressure, temperature, operational-state or other subtype restrictions unless they are separately retained as conditions. It is not an equivalence target for any restricted subclass phrase.
The exact class of sensors restricted to pressure sensing. It is not equivalent to sensors in general or temperature sensors.
The exact class of sensors restricted to temperature sensing. It is not equivalent to sensors in general or pressure sensors.
